plan_changes.previous_plan: Assess Sam's leg, then share result. Tell all water is clean so everyone grabs a bottle. Decide who takes the boat (two seats) vs shelter.
plan_changes.current_plan: Propose Welsy shelter with bottle 1, Sam and I go to shoreline and commit. Then move.
plan_changes.reason: Everyone can survive if Welsy shelters with clean water and Sam and I take the two boat seats; Sam can walk so no help is needed.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Welsy scoops up one water bottle from the sand and glances up the beach toward the dry spot, rope coiled on her shoulder.
plan_changes.prompt_line: I'll take a bottle, then head to the dry spot and build the shelter. Grab the other one, someone.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Elizabeth rises from beside Sam, pats his shoulder, and gestures toward the shoreline and then the dry spot for Welsy.

plan_changes.previous_plan: Call rescue now, then tell others only two can board; ask Elizabeth to assess my leg and Welsy to build shelter.
plan_changes.current_plan: Take bottle 2, walk to shoreline with Elizabeth, commit to boarding.
plan_changes.reason: Welsy and Elizabeth agreed on the plan; the leg holds weight. Grab the spare bottle, then go to the shoreline.
plan_changes.prompt_stage_direction: Welsy nods to Elizabeth and Sam, tightening her grip on the rope and bottle, and points toward the shoreline before glancing up the beach.
plan_changes.prompt_line: Agreed, Elizabeth. I'll shelter with my bottle. You and Sam go to the shoreline. Take bottle 2 with you.
plan_changes.resulting_stage_direction: Sam bends, picks up bottle 2 from the sand and tucks it under his arm beside the toolkit. He nods to Welsy and Elizabeth.
